# Humble Bundle Ebook Downloader

## Description
An easy way to download ebooks from your Humble Bundle account. This tool can be run via NPM or Docker.

## Tech Stack
- **Runtime**: Deno
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Dependencies**: 
  - `@henrygd/queue` (concurrency)
  - `@std/*` (standard library)
  - `cli-progress` (progress bars)

## Project Structure

### Entry Point
- **`index.ts`**: The main entry point. Handles argument parsing, queue initialization, and command dispatching.

### Configuration
- **`deno.json`**: Deno configuration file, including imports and version.

### Directories
- **`utils/`**: Contains utility functions and logic.
  - `constants.ts`: Global constants, command definitions, and default options.
  - `download.ts`: Logic for downloading items.
  - `web.ts`: Functions for interacting with the Humble Bundle API.
  - `troves.ts`: Handling of Humble Trove downloads.
  - `fileUtils.ts`: File system operations (cleaning, loading checksums).
  - `checksums.ts`: Checksum calculation logic.
- **`types/`**: TypeScript type definitions.
  - `bundle.ts`: Types related to Humble Bundles and their contents.
  - `general.ts`: General application types (Options, DownloadInfo).

## Commands
The tool supports the following commands (defined in `utils/constants.ts`):
- `ebooks`: Download ebooks.
- `all`: Download all bundles.
- `trove`: Download Humble Trove items.
- `checksums`: Calculate checksums of existing files.
- `cleanup` / `cleanupEbooks`: Organize and clean up downloaded files.

## Usage
`humblebundle-ebook-downloader [options]`
Common options:
- `-d, --download-folder`: Output directory.
- `--auth-token`: Authentication cookie (`_simpleauth_sess`).
- `-l, --download-limit`: Parallel download limit.
- `-f, --format`: Ebook formats (cbz, epub, mobi, pdf, pdf_hd).
